svg.title: Audio and Video Quality: a picture and sound score every minute, and how a zap is timed, in one image
svg.text: A picture and sound score, every minute, 24 h
Every device, every minute: what it really shows and plays
Black or frozen frames do not count.
Sharp is 5, the worst is 2. A silent minute scores 0.
Close to −23, little silence, no clipping: a good sound.
Both scores are kept for every device, one row a minute, for 7 days
Quick, approximate scores, not a certified measure.
Key press to new picture, with the black time inside it
